description: Failover (F), redistribution (R) and autoscale (A) phases of the large audio mesh, each group one held step of listeners on curve 1 (five edges a region). Every scenario: a baseline, the fault at baseline_s, an observation, the restore, a settle. A kill is SIGKILL and then the unit stopped (Restart=always would bring it back in 2 s; low-latency ops D4); a crash is the SIGKILL alone, the 2 s restart (F2r). Fault sizes against five serving edges a region: at most 2 of 5 at once (D5). LL-HLS readers are needletail-reader crowds that follow steering and move; their entry points and the liveness check are nodes that no phase faults. scale-run.py run --phase-plan deploy/low-latency/phases-scale.json --group F|R|A. needs_am names what a scenario still waits for before it can pass (only F9 now: C CL7 cleared it where the resilient-mesh builds judge it). Every scenario has probes of its own on the view hosts and is scored alone by the referee's change-window.py on its own marks (C CL7); the controller runs `--until join` or `--until stopped`. deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md has the cost, the shedding order and the local proofs.

scenarios.name: F3
scenarios.title: drain then stop tok-dist-a (a forwarder, not the ingress)

scenarios.name: F7
scenarios.title: kill 2 of London's 5 edges at once

scenarios.name: F8
scenarios.title: kill one edge and one distributor in every region at once

scenarios.name: F9
scenarios.title: lose Tokyo whole (edges and distributors): a few hundred Opus listeners resume in a neighbouring region over the public path
needs_am: public-path Opus listeners in scale-run (not built: VLAN listeners cannot leave their region)
scenarios.note: Not run until UDP region failover (AM item 11) lands and the run has a small public-path Opus listener group; reported as an open gap. Listeners on the VLAN cannot reach another region, and 1 ms PCM over the public network is billed transfer beyond the receiving edges' egress (critique 20).

scenarios.name: R1
scenarios.title: a standby edge joins under load (start lon-edge-6)

scenarios.name: R2
scenarios.title: drain the edge that joined (lon-edge-6), then hold it out

scenarios.name: R3
scenarios.title: kill lon-edge-5 (node loss): who takes its readers, at what cost

scenarios.name: R4
scenarios.title: lon-dist-c (created and pushed before the step, held out) joins, then is killed
scenarios.note: lon-dist-c is created and pushed before the step (lab add lon-dist-c --budget-usd ...; deploy push --nodes lon-dist-c; deploy stop --nodes lon-dist-c), about $0.11 for its two billed hours. Expect about 2/3 of the (edge, stream) pairs to change one parent when a third forwarder joins two (C 2.11).

scenarios.name: R5
scenarios.title: catch-up storm: 2 of London's 5 edges drain at once
scenarios.note: largest_burst_per_tick: the distributor's total warm-up cap (cache_mesh_warm_total_kbps, the binaries' 40,000 kbit/s) over one 20 ms sync tick of the cache mesh, in bytes

shedding: When the run's projected end passes 345 min of the lab's life (5.75 h; the watchdog's down starts at 355 min and the lab is gone at 6.0 h): first the joins of the representative steps not yet run, then what is left of the 10 min of reruns, then curve 1's c1-opus1-mixed, then half of curve 2's steps (SCALE.md), then the scenarios, the lowest `shed` first: F8, R5, F2r, R4, F7, ... ; 0 is not run until its Phase AM work lands.

schedule.description: The whole large-mesh run in six billed hours, as agreed with the referee on 22 November: no Sydney (69 nodes, $7.884 an hour), the watchdog armed for 6.0 h from the lab's creation (its down starts 5 min before), the schedule ending at least margin_min before that down. Two windows run first, with the referee's own tools on this lab (A: the wave 7 audio headline; B: 4K with GSO); then the ramps and the phase groups. A fixed block is timed by estimate (minutes); a block with `run` is the scale-run.py run command (without $COST) and is timed by `scale-run.py plan` itself, which reports the total (`schedule` in plan --json). A refused core stops the run with no retry; nothing is added past this schedule. deploy/low-latency/SCALE.md has the commands.

blocks.name: bring-up
blocks.what: lab up --without-sites sydney (69 nodes, staged), bootstrap and push in the windows' settings (one edge a region, public path, GSO on), the referee's gobuild, prepare (4K indexes of clips6-full), livekit, audio and secrets, scale-run.py prepare, and the 4K clips (five rungs, 6.4 GB) onto lon-src

blocks.name: A-headline
blocks.what: wave 7 audio headline, the referee's compare-audio.py: session scale-w7 (opus-2.5 with 1 ms Opus Custom, pcm with 1 ms PCM; about 15 min) and scale-w7-std (standard 2.5 ms Opus; about 7.5 min), lanes lkregion, nt-popus/nt-pcm (LL-HLS, -w, -h3) and nt-uc, phases baseline, joins (20 a lane) and impair (1%, 5%, burst, and the harness's 100 ms delay)

blocks.name: B-4k-gso
blocks.what: 4K with GSO, the referee's compare-run.py --lanes nt --phases throughput, rungs 2160p25, 40, 80, 160, 240 (about 80 s a rung; the sweep ends early after two rungs that reach no region whole): contributor, one edge a region, the view hosts on the public path, no simulated listeners

blocks.name: restart-e2
blocks.what: deploy restart $(scale-run.py settings --edges-per-region 2): the VLAN, two edges a region

blocks.name: restart-c1
blocks.what: deploy restart $(scale-run.py settings): five edges a region

blocks.name: start-standby
blocks.what: deploy start --nodes (the standby edges): ten edges a region

blocks.name: down
blocks.what: scale-run.py stop, lab down, the VLAN and leftover check

cuts: 1. joins only at representative steps: c1-pcm-udp's first step (100) and 10,000 (where five edges a region reach about 93% of their outbound cap at 1 ms PCM without Sydney), and the top of curve 1 (c1-opus25-udp's 40,000), plus all of (A): 3 ramp steps instead of 53, 66.6 min saved (437.7 min before any cut, 371.1 after this one)
2. reruns: 40 min (10 of phases, 30 of steps) cut to 10, 30 min saved (341.1 min)

3. C CL7 (24 Nov): every scenario has probes of its own, held long enough after its change for the referee's no-change windows (360 s at least), and R4 and A3 are enabled: the schedule grew to 421.6 min with R4 and A3 named out of it. Shed in the agreed order until it fitted: the joins of the representative steps (417.6), the 10 min of reruns (407.6), c1-opus1-mixed (395.5), half of curve 2's steps (375.8), then the scenarios F8, R5, F2r, F7 and F5 (341.3).
not cut: phases F (F1, F2, F3, F4, F6), R (R1, R2, R3), A (A1, A2), the rest of curve 1 and curve 2, and the LiveKit control
